♍ The Virgo Cloth. [CONTROL]

Cloth Passive — Om

Shaka fights with his eyes closed and opens them only when he intends to end things.

As a single action (concentrate) you may close your eyes. While your eyes are closed you are blinded — fully, with all that entails — but you gain one Om stack at the end of each of your turns, to a maximum of 5.

While you have at least 1 stack you gain a +1 status bonus per stack to your Technique DCs and to unarmed Strike damage. From 7th level your Sixth Sense functions as a precise sense out to 30 feet, letting you fight blind.

Opening your eyes is a free action, usable at any time. All stacks are spent and reset to 0, and the next Technique you cast or unarmed Strike you make before the end of that turn is empowered: +2 damage dice per stack spent, and if it allows a saving throw, a −1 circumstance penalty per 2 stacks spent to that save.

Your eyes open automatically, spending nothing, if you are knocked unconscious.

Use @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Om] ◆ to close your eyes and @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Open Your Eyes] to spend the stacks; the count lives on @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: Om], which also applies the blinded condition for as long as your eyes are closed. It is a real cost and the sheet enforces it.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Tenbu Hōrin]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Tenpōrin'in]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Tenma Kōfuku]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Rikudō Rinne]

Ascendant Boon — Six Paths of Transmigration [CONTROL]

Each unarmed hit forces a Will save against your Cosmo DC or the target loses a sense, cumulatively: blind → deaf → smell/taste → touch (−4 to attacks, cannot Grapple). Removed only by restoration or a full rest.

Your maximum Om stacks increase to 7.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Virgo)]

Zenith Boon — Six Paths of Transmigration (Zenith) [CONTROL]

As the Ascendant Boon, plus once per minute ◆◆◆, 60-foot emanation, Will save (incapacitation) or lose all five senses for 1 minute; a critical failure lasts until restoration.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Virgo)]

rules.text: Close your eyes (1 action, concentrate) to become blinded and gain 1 Om stack at the end of each turn, max 5. Open them (free) to spend all stacks and empower your next Technique or unarmed Strike by +2 damage dice per stack.
